text:
Nina (PM): Quick thread  proposing a 5-week prioritized pilot: 6 partners, split into 'throughput' and 'compliance' lanes. Main ask: nail intake + prioritization rules so Sales can qualify fast.
Dev (Eng): +1. We need a clear perf/regression matrix and a minimal probe suite. Suggest 15 canonical prompts for initial evals.
Rhea (ProdOps): Ops checklist: signed access SLA, pre-onboard dry-run, and a rollback snapshot. Capacity: reserve 1.25x expected peak per partner week1.
Ike (Design): Intake should be two views: quick filter for Sales (3 fields) and detailed onboarding checklist for partners. I'll produce both.
Ola (CS): Incentive experiment: A/B credit vs co-marketing. Track conversion to paid at 30 days. Also propose 15-min onboarding office hours in week1.
Nina (PM): Proposed launch gates: (A) 4/6 partners onboarded in 14 days, (B) no more than one sev1 across cohort, (C) synthetic regression < 4% on our eval suite. Agree?
Dev (Eng): Agree but add instrumentation gate: p95 telemetry must stream to Console for each partner before we flip traffic.
Rhea (ProdOps): Legal requirement for private partners: DPA signed + network access checklist. LegalBot  can you flag missing clauses?
LegalBot: DPA checklist queued. Include: data retention, audit rights, and encryption at rest. Route draft to legal-review.
Ike (Design): Screening snippet for Sales: `1) 1-sentence use-case 2) tokens/day 3) lane (throughput/compliance) 4) legal ready?` I'll post a Google Form link in #product.
Ola (CS): Feedback loop design: weekly 3-question pulse, in-product regression button, and a mid-cohort 30m interview. I'll run the first surveys.
Nina (PM): Prioritization rules idea: assign numeric weight to signals (tokens/day x2, legal readiness x3, product fit x1). Top score gets earlier slot. Thoughts?
Dev (Eng): Numeric weighting is good. For rollouts: feature flag per partner + fallback to quantized-model if latency>SLO. Snippet: `if p95>target -> route:quantized`.
Rhea (ProdOps): Add an abort rule: if total GPU util > 80% for >20m, pause new onboardings and notify on-call.
Ike (Design): I'll design a one-pager for partners that includes expected timelines, checkpoints, and a short prompt-mapping template.
Ola (CS): For acceptance criteria post-pilot: 1) onboarding complete, 2) <4% regressions, 3) partner indicates willingness to continue. We should instrument a simple accept/decline flow.
Nina (PM): Great. Recruitment plan: Sales to provide 12 leads, we'll screen down to 6. OutreachBot  can you create a sheet and auto-tag leads?
OutreachBot: Sheet created: https://redwood.example.com/sheets/cohort-prioritization-pilot. Add leads and tag lane.
Dev (Eng): Implementation task: prepare synthetic probe endpoint and a small CI job: `POST /evals/run?suite=pilot-15`. Results -> Console + #product-alerts.
Rhea (ProdOps): I'll draft the access SLA and a partner sign-off checklist. Also propose a 48h pre-onboard smoke slot for each partner.
Ike (Design): Posting sales filter + one-pager to #product in 30m.
Ola (CS): I'll draft incentive copy and coordinate credits with Finance. Also scheduling for office hours.
Nina (PM): Action items: Ike = one-pager + form, Dev = probe + routing snippet, Rhea = SLA + dry-run schedule, Ola = incentive + survey, LegalBot = DPA draft. Reconvene Tue 10am. Any blockers?
Dev (Eng): Need eng-sre support for routing controller. I'll ping them after.
Rhea (ProdOps): Legal flagged one item (audit clause) I'll loop Legal in.
Ike (Design): No blockers.
Ola (CS): No blockers. Will start outreach after Sales feeds leads.
Nina (PM): Thanks team  let's keep intake tight and capture scope-change requests as separate paid work. I'll post two sample partner profiles in the sheet for Sales to use as templates. :seedling:
